reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Directorate-General for Neighbourhood and Enlargement Negotiations

title.narrative: Visibility and Public Diplomacy in the Republic of Moldova 2024

description.narrative:
The overall objective to which this action contributes is to support EU public diplomacy and increased visibility of the EU and the EU assistance provided to the Republic of Moldova, while providing targeted information on tangible results for the Moldovan citizens. The focus of the public diplomacy effort of this contract should be the EU values and assistance provided to the country, taking as reference the new candidacy role of Moldova and its path to EU accession, but also the framework of the Association Agreement (AA) and the Deep and Comprehensive Free Trade Agreement (DCFTA).


In addition to this, the project will be focused on ensuring communication support for the actions funded by the European Union and its Member States and what EU accession means for Moldova given the new candidacy role of the country.

title.narrative: The overall objective to which this action contributes is to support EU public diplomacy and increased visibility of the EU and the EU assistance provided to the Republic of Moldova, while providing targeted information on tangible results for the Moldovan citizens. The focus of the public diplomacy effort of this contract should be the EU values and assistance provided to the country, taking as reference the new candidacy role of Moldova and its path to EU accession, but also the framework of the Association Agreement (AA) and the Deep and Comprehensive Free Trade Agreement (DCFTA). In addition to this, the project will be focused on ensuring communication support for the actions funded by the European Union and its Member States and what EU accession means for Moldova given the new candidacy role of the country.
